name: Ip2_ViscElMat_ViscElMat_MultiViscElPhys
description: Handles the MultiViscElPhys physical description of the contact between two ViscElMats<ViscElMat>. Contact stiffnesses (for every contact<MultiViscElPhys.contacts>) are directly assigned from below attributes, independent of ViscElMat properties. Contact friction angle is taken as the minimum of...

attributes.name: kn
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining how to compute interaction's normal stiffness. If None, harmonic average is used.

attributes.name: ks
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining how to compute interaction's shear stiffness. If None, harmonic average is used.

attributes.name: en
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining how to compute interaction's normal coefficient of restitution. If None, harmonic average is used.

attributes.name: et
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining how to compute interaction's shear coefficient of restitution. If None, harmonic average is used.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
